title: ervum alpestre
intro: Ervum alpestre, commonly known as mountain clover or sweet clover, is a perennial flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Ervum alpestre include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
